groups.sentence: Instructors weigh AI's educational value, benefits, risks, ethics and their own values before deciding whether to use it in teaching.
Students weigh the benefits, risks and ethics of AI, and judge whether it is appropriate, before using it for a task.
Everyone using AI weighs its potential benefits and risks, and considers its impacts, before and while using it.
Everyone decides whether to use AI deliberately, considering necessity, resource cost and goals; availability alone does not justify use.
Students make informed, intentional choices about when and how to use AI.
Whether and how AI use is acceptable depends on the specific use, and people may make informed decisions or use it for personal exploration.
